categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/net_processing.cpp to refactor PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage() into per-message handlers.
categories.rationale: Extracting message handling logic from the monolithic ProcessMessage into dedicated helpers improves maintainability and navigation in net_processing. However, it is an internal move-only refactoring that does not fix bugs, alter protocol behavior, or retire a known hazard in message handling.
